title: Topline Pro Advice Line: Matt Hitchcock with The Grass Guys CLC, LLC
summary: We’re proud to work alongside thousands of small business owners who are dedicated to serving their communities, delivering high-quality work, and sharing their expertise. Today, we’re excited to feature Matt Hitchcock, owner and operator of The Grass Guys Complete Lawn Care, LLC, based in Evansville, IN. Matt brings a personal touch to every project, ensuring each customer receives top-notch service. Recently, The Grass Guys CLC, LLC was honored as one of the top three finalists in the Lawn Care and Landscaping Company category for the 2024 Evansville Community's Choice Awards.
